label: candidate design ablation (D6)

candidate_rule.K10: unchanged projected 3x3 offset grid followed by B0 command
candidate_rule.K50: ceil(sqrt(K-2)) square offsets over [-delta,delta]^2; evenly spaced flattened grid indices for K-2; append projected hold and projected B0; retain duplicate projected actions
candidate_rule.projection: same box and per-step slew limits as the archived controller

objective: For each candidate, average squared tracking error over H forecast steps and 128-point score grid, then add the unchanged single-decision effort, slew, and state-penalty terms from Eq. (3). Feedback-rollout scores its H-step state path but its first action incurs the decision action terms.

forecast.burgers: unchanged 256-point FP64 CUDA IMEX/RK4 reference; every control step is 80 inner steps at dt=2.5e-4; score at every H endpoint on indices 0,2,...,254
forecast.heat: unchanged 256-point cell-interior Crank-Nicolson reference, dt=0.02; score by unchanged 128-point restriction
forecast.feedback_rollout: one additional candidate, initialized by B0's current command; at each future control step recompute the same seven-mode B0 feedback law from the predicted full state and project against the rollout's preceding action; execute only the rollout's first command

seals.sample_policy: all X1a/X1c cells and both PDEs use the same first 128 scenario IDs sorted ascending lexically by actual scenario ID; independently run full384 Burgers K10_H8 first as the reference-reproduction anchor, then use its matched 128 rows for paired cells; run heat K10_H8 on the same first128 cohort
seals.primary_baseline: Full384 Burgers K10_H8 must reproduce both target mean 0.341698 and archived raw full-precision mean within absolute 0.0000005 (six-decimal rounding half-unit); stop if either fails. Per-scenario/action/choice differences are diagnostics only and cannot change the threshold.
seals.branch_rule: a fixed-action cell at <= 0.5 times its paired K10_H8 excess cost selects branch A; if none, but feedback-rollout is <=0.5 times baseline, branch C; otherwise branch B

bootstrap.interval: pointwise percentile 2.5% and 97.5%; same PCG64 seed and resampling convention as frozen E1 interval audit

locked_execution_budget: User-authorized approximately 4 hours; first128 fixed for all ablation cells, full384 Burgers K10_H8 anchor
test_seal_status: FROZEN_IN_X1_PLAN_COMMIT; commit SHA, commit UTC, and exact source hashes recorded in evidence/X1_FREEZE_RECORD.json
